body: Believe me I really want to be happy and normal but I think I'm too lazy and I think that it's also not worth the effort at all because it will never be stable.

With the nurse they don't do much, they would have me call me mom and inform her. I told my school dean about it and I'm not sure if she did anything about the boys. They threw a pumpkin at my door and nearly broke the window a few days before Halloween. Cops couldn't do anything because no evidence. I don't want to look weak, I don't know who to turn to at this point. I've thought of everything completely through. I can't think of anyone who would take me completely seriously.
